tasks.acceptance_prose:
## Background
This repo has a Word-parity contract layer: `tests/parity/word-parity-overrides.json` defines executable UI
contracts keyed by ledger binding tokens; `tests/parity/contract-runner.cjs` runs them against the live editor
(a docserver binary serves /word/; playwright clicks controls and asserts effects). CI job
'Word Parity Contracts (L2+)' enforces this layer. Your worktree is branched from main at 77b0bc3ad —
the layer currently has 16 passing contracts / 0 FAIL / 1 known-gap.

## Deliverable
ONE new file: `tests/parity/overrides-dropins/find.json`. Touch NOTHING else. Shape:
{"entries": {"<key>": {...}}, "$skipped": [{"row": "...", "reason": "..."}]} ($skipped optional, for rows you drop).
Key = the row's binding TOKEN (lowercased data-cmd value) OR the FEATURE ID — use the FEATURE ID whenever two
ledger rows share a token, so each row gets its own contract.
Entry fields:
- "effektClass": one of dialog|format|structure|op|view (anything else is skipped by the runner).
- "selector": CSS for the control to click, default '[data-cmd="<token>"]'. If that data-cmd exists on MORE THAN
  ONE control, scope it: '.ribbon-page[data-tab="<tab>"] [data-cmd="<token>"]' — the runner clicks the FIRST
  match and a hidden duplicate breaks it (the displayMode bug).
- "woTab": ribbon tab holding the control (valid: home, insert, layout, references, review, view, collaboration,
  draw, protection, plugins, ai, chart-design, header-footer). OMIT for backstage/statusbar/dialog controls.
- "pre": 'file-menu' for backstage entries. Do not invent other values.
- "assertion": dialog => {"kind":"dialog-visible","dialogSelector":"#<dialog-id>"}
  format => {"kind":"computed-style","prop":"<css-prop>","equals":"<value>"} — asserted on the element of the
  FIRST word in the editor (the runner selects it before clicking; e.g. bold -> font-weight:"700").
  view/doc-level toggle => {"kind":"viewport-flag","rootSelector":"main","hasClass":"<class>"} or
  {"kind":"viewport-flag","rootSelector":"#editor","prop":"zoom","equals":"1.1"}.
- "subFeatures": REQUIRED for dialog-visible: [{"name":"...","selector":"#inner-id"}] — every selector is
  checked INSIDE the visible dialog; one missing = FAIL. List the dialog's REAL sub-controls only (grep markup).
- "post": optional selector clicked after the assertion (dialog OK/close) — use when leaving something open
  could bleed into later contracts (zoom, view modes, dialogs).
- "xfail": true + "note" when the row is a REAL parity gap (control exists but the promised dialog/effect never
  appears). xfail counts as known-gap, not FAIL. Prefer honest xfail over silently dropping a row.
- "note": cite the ledger feature id you are covering.

## Non-negotiable workflow
1. READ tests/parity/word-parity-overrides.json (examples: 'bold', 'toggledropcap', 'file.view'),
   tests/parity/overrides-dropins/pilot.json, and tests/parity/contract-runner.cjs (checkEffect + main loop).
2. GREP-BEFORE-TRUST: for EVERY row below verify in apps/web/apps/documenteditor-wysiwyg/index.html and
   editor.js that (a) the trigger control exists, (b) clicking it really opens the dialog / applies the effect.
   If the binding is wrong or the effect differs, adapt the contract to the REAL behavior or xfail with a note.
3. Write the JSON, then from the worktree root run:
   bash tests/parity/af-gate.sh $((16 + PASSING))
   (PASSING = number of non-xfail entries you committed). Exit 0 required. Iterate. Never install anything;
   node/playwright/binary are provided. /usr/bin/node is the ONLY working node binary.
4. Commit ONLY your drop-in file, message: feat(L2C): <what you contracted>.

## Your rows (from the parity ledger census)

- file.find-ctrl-f (token 'btn-find', tab home): opens #find-dialog. subFeatures from the real markup
  (e.g. find query input, btn-find-next, replace row if present).
- formatting.replace-ctrl-h (token 'btn-replace', tab home): grep what btn-replace really does — if it opens
  the same find dialog with the replace row visible, contract it as dialog-visible #find-dialog; if it opens
  something else, contract what is real; if nothing, xfail.
Expected: 2 passing entries (gate 18).
